sequential/iphone13/ch01-establish-end.j.caption: A 248-base-pair gene in a patch of E. coli cytoplasm. Everything here is at true scale, built from experimental structures.

sequential/iphone13/ch02-search-end.jpg.title: Finding the promoter
sequential/iphone13/ch02-search-end.jpg.caption: RNA polymerase holoenzyme scans the DNA. Its σ⁷⁰ subunit (violet) recognises the −35 TTGACA and −10 TATAAT promoter elements.

sequential/iphone13/ch02-search-mid.jpg.title: Finding the promoter
sequential/iphone13/ch02-search-mid.jpg.caption: RNA polymerase holoenzyme scans the DNA. Its σ⁷⁰ subunit (violet) recognises the −35 TTGACA and −10 TATAAT promoter elements.

sequential/iphone13/ch03-open-end.jpg.title: Opening the DNA
sequential/iphone13/ch03-open-end.jpg.caption: σ⁷⁰ melts about 13 base pairs around the start site. The template strand enters the active site and the DNA bends sharply.

sequential/iphone13/ch03-open-mid.jpg.title: Opening the DNA
sequential/iphone13/ch03-open-mid.jpg.caption: σ⁷⁰ melts about 13 base pairs around the start site. The template strand enters the active site and the DNA bends sharply.

sequential/iphone13/ch04-initiate-end.jp.title: First bonds
sequential/iphone13/ch04-initiate-end.jp.caption: Each incoming NTP pairs with the template. The RNA 3′-OH attacks its α-phosphate, adding one nucleotide and releasing pyrophosphate.

sequential/iphone13/ch04-initiate-mid.jp.title: First bonds
sequential/iphone13/ch04-initiate-mid.jp.caption: Each incoming NTP pairs with the template. The RNA 3′-OH attacks its α-phosphate, adding one nucleotide and releasing pyrophosphate.

sequential/iphone13/ch04-initiate-start..title: First bonds
sequential/iphone13/ch04-initiate-start..caption: Each incoming NTP pairs with the template. The RNA 3′-OH attacks its α-phosphate, adding one nucleotide and releasing pyrophosphate.

sequential/iphone13/ch05-escape-end.jpg.title: Promoter escape
sequential/iphone13/ch05-escape-end.jpg.caption: After about 12 nucleotides the enzyme leaves the promoter. Here σ⁷⁰ is shown leaving; in cells it often stays bound for longer.

sequential/iphone13/ch05-escape-mid.jpg.title: Promoter escape
sequential/iphone13/ch05-escape-mid.jpg.caption: After about 12 nucleotides the enzyme leaves the promoter. Here σ⁷⁰ is shown leaving; in cells it often stays bound for longer.

sequential/iphone13/ch05-escape-start.jp.title: Promoter escape
sequential/iphone13/ch05-escape-start.jp.caption: After about 12 nucleotides the enzyme leaves the promoter. Here σ⁷⁰ is shown leaving; in cells it often stays bound for longer.

sequential/iphone13/ch06-elongate-tx-end.title: Elongation
sequential/iphone13/ch06-elongate-tx-end.caption: The polymerase reads the template 3′→5′ and builds RNA 5′→3′. About nine base pairs of RNA·DNA hybrid stay inside; the DNA re-closes behind.

sequential/iphone13/ch06-elongate-tx-mid.title: Elongation
sequential/iphone13/ch06-elongate-tx-mid.caption: The polymerase reads the template 3′→5′ and builds RNA 5′→3′. About nine base pairs of RNA·DNA hybrid stay inside; the DNA re-closes behind.

sequential/iphone13/ch07-terminate-tx-en.title: Termination
sequential/iphone13/ch07-terminate-tx-en.caption: A GC-rich hairpin folds in the new RNA as the U-tract is copied. The weak U·A hybrid gives way, releasing the RNA and the DNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch07-terminate-tx-mi.title: Termination
sequential/iphone13/ch07-terminate-tx-mi.caption: A GC-rich hairpin folds in the new RNA as the U-tract is copied. The weak U·A hybrid gives way, releasing the RNA and the DNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch07-terminate-tx-st.title: Termination

sequential/iphone13/ch08-scan-end.jpg.title: Ribosome meets mRNA
sequential/iphone13/ch08-scan-end.jpg.caption: The 30S subunit, with IF1 and IF3, finds the Shine–Dalgarno sequence AGGAGG by pairing it with the 3′ end of its 16S rRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch08-scan-mid.jpg.title: Ribosome meets mRNA
sequential/iphone13/ch08-scan-mid.jpg.caption: The 30S subunit, with IF1 and IF3, finds the Shine–Dalgarno sequence AGGAGG by pairing it with the 3′ end of its 16S rRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch08-scan-start.jpg.title: Ribosome meets mRNA
sequential/iphone13/ch08-scan-start.jpg.caption: The 30S subunit, with IF1 and IF3, finds the Shine–Dalgarno sequence AGGAGG by pairing it with the 3′ end of its 16S rRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch09-start-end.jpg.title: Start codon
sequential/iphone13/ch09-start-end.jpg.caption: IF2 brings the initiator fMet-tRNA to the P site, where its anticodon pairs with AUG. This sets the reading frame.

sequential/iphone13/ch09-start-mid.jpg.title: Start codon
sequential/iphone13/ch09-start-mid.jpg.caption: IF2 brings the initiator fMet-tRNA to the P site, where its anticodon pairs with AUG. This sets the reading frame.

sequential/iphone13/ch09-start-start.jpg.title: Start codon
sequential/iphone13/ch09-start-start.jpg.caption: IF2 brings the initiator fMet-tRNA to the P site, where its anticodon pairs with AUG. This sets the reading frame.

sequential/iphone13/ch10-join-end.jpg.title: 70S assembly
sequential/iphone13/ch10-join-end.jpg.caption: The 50S subunit joins. IF3 and IF1 leave, and IF2 hydrolyses GTP and departs, leaving a 70S ribosome ready to read codon 2.

sequential/iphone13/ch10-join-mid.jpg.title: 70S assembly
sequential/iphone13/ch10-join-mid.jpg.caption: The 50S subunit joins. IF3 and IF1 leave, and IF2 hydrolyses GTP and departs, leaving a 70S ribosome ready to read codon 2.

sequential/iphone13/ch10-join-start.jpg.title: 70S assembly
sequential/iphone13/ch10-join-start.jpg.caption: The 50S subunit joins. IF3 and IF1 leave, and IF2 hydrolyses GTP and departs, leaving a 70S ribosome ready to read codon 2.

sequential/iphone13/ch11-decode-end.jpg.title: Decoding
sequential/iphone13/ch11-decode-end.jpg.caption: EF-Tu brings an aminoacyl-tRNA to the A site. When its anticodon pairs with the codon, EF-Tu hydrolyses GTP and releases the tRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch11-decode-mid.jpg.title: Decoding
sequential/iphone13/ch11-decode-mid.jpg.caption: EF-Tu brings an aminoacyl-tRNA to the A site. When its anticodon pairs with the codon, EF-Tu hydrolyses GTP and releases the tRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch11-decode-start.jp.title: Decoding
sequential/iphone13/ch11-decode-start.jp.caption: EF-Tu brings an aminoacyl-tRNA to the A site. When its anticodon pairs with the codon, EF-Tu hydrolyses GTP and releases the tRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch12-bond-end.jpg.title: Peptide bond
sequential/iphone13/ch12-bond-end.jpg.caption: In the peptidyl-transferase centre of the 23S rRNA, the new amino acid attacks the ester bond. The growing chain moves to the A-site tRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch12-bond-mid.jpg.title: Peptide bond
sequential/iphone13/ch12-bond-mid.jpg.caption: In the peptidyl-transferase centre of the 23S rRNA, the new amino acid attacks the ester bond. The growing chain moves to the A-site tRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch12-bond-start.jpg.title: Peptide bond
sequential/iphone13/ch12-bond-start.jpg.caption: In the peptidyl-transferase centre of the 23S rRNA, the new amino acid attacks the ester bond. The growing chain moves to the A-site tRNA.

sequential/iphone13/ch13-translocate-end.title: Translocation
sequential/iphone13/ch13-translocate-end.caption: EF-G uses GTP to move both tRNAs and the mRNA by exactly one codon: A to P, P to E. The A site is empty again.

sequential/iphone13/ch13-translocate-mid.title: Translocation
sequential/iphone13/ch13-translocate-mid.caption: EF-G uses GTP to move both tRNAs and the mRNA by exactly one codon: A to P, P to E. The A site is empty again.

sequential/iphone13/ch13-translocate-sta.title: Translocation

sequential/iphone13/ch14-elongate-tl-end.title: Elongation
sequential/iphone13/ch14-elongate-tl-end.caption: Each cycle adds one amino acid to the C-terminus. The chain threads through the 50S exit tunnel and emerges after about 26 residues.

sequential/iphone13/ch14-elongate-tl-mid.title: Elongation
sequential/iphone13/ch14-elongate-tl-mid.caption: Each cycle adds one amino acid to the C-terminus. The chain threads through the 50S exit tunnel and emerges after about 26 residues.

sequential/iphone13/ch15-release-end.jpg.title: Stop codon
sequential/iphone13/ch15-release-end.jpg.caption: UAA has no tRNA. Release factor RF1 reads it in the A site and its GGQ motif hydrolyses the ester bond, freeing the 40-residue peptide.

sequential/iphone13/ch15-release-mid.jpg.title: Stop codon
sequential/iphone13/ch15-release-mid.jpg.caption: UAA has no tRNA. Release factor RF1 reads it in the A site and its GGQ motif hydrolyses the ester bond, freeing the 40-residue peptide.

sequential/iphone13/ch15-release-start.j.title: Stop codon
sequential/iphone13/ch15-release-start.j.caption: UAA has no tRNA. Release factor RF1 reads it in the A site and its GGQ motif hydrolyses the ester bond, freeing the 40-residue peptide.

sequential/iphone13/ch16-finale-end.jpg.title: Finished
sequential/iphone13/ch16-finale-end.jpg.caption: One gene, one transcript, one peptide. More ribosomes could read the same mRNA; the peptide would now fold, which is not modelled here.
